roots.name: VHH::Core::Geometry::property_gradient
roots.documentation:
### ***property_gradient*** This compound returns the gradient of a `geo_property` as vectors.
*** ## Input ***in_geo***
The geometry carrying the property. ***property***
The property to calculate the gradient of. ***property_type***
The type of property to calculate the gradient of. *** ## Output ***property_gradient***
The property gradient vectors. ***property_gradient_normalized***
The normalized property gradient vectors.

_notes.text:
Like a Johnny Appleseed of geometric elements, inside here
we visit all the vertices we're made of, sprinkling 
around neighbors
